G3303.def:
μέν, 
conjunctive particle (originally a form of μήν), usually related to a following δέ or other adversative conjunction, and distinguishing the word or clause with which it stands from that which follows. 
It is generally untranslatable and is not nearly so frequent in NT as in cl. Like δέ, it never stands first in a clause. 
__1. Answered by δέ or some other particle: μὲν . . . δέ, indeed . . . but, Matthieu 3:11, Luc 3:16, al.; with pronouns, ὃς μὲν . . . ὃς δέ, one . . . another, Matthieu 21:35, al.; pl., Philippiens 1:16, 17; ὃ μὲν . . . ὃ δὲ . . . ὃ δέ, some . . . some . . . some, Matthieu 13:8; τοῦτο μὲν . . . τοῦτο δέ, partly . . . partly, Hébreux 10:33; μὲν . . . ἔπειτα, Jean 11:6; μὲν . . . καί, Luc 8:5. 
__2. μέν solitarium, answered by no other particle: πρῶτον μέν (Bl., l.with), Romains 1:8 3:2, 1 Corinthiens 11:18; μὲν οὖν in narrative, summing up what precedes or introducing something further (Bl., §78, 5), so then, rather, nay rather: Luc 11:28 (WH, μενοῦν), Actes 1:6 9:31, al.; μὲν οὖν γε (Philippiens 3:8, WH): see: μενοῦνγε.

G3304.def:
μεν-οῦν-γε
= μὲν οὖν γε
nay rather: Romains 9:20 10:18, Philippiens 3:8.†

G3305.def:
μέν-τοι
= μέν τοι, 
yet, however: Jean 4:27, al.; εἰ μ., Jacques 2:8 (if indeed).

G3308.def:
μέριμνα, -ης, ἡ 
[in LXX: Psaumes 55:22 (יְהַב), Job 11:18, Sir.30:24, al ;] (in cl. chiefly poët.) 
care, anxiety: 1 Pierre 5:7; pl., Luc 8:14 21:34; with genitive obj., Matthieu 13:22, Marc 4:19, 2 Corinthiens 11:28.†

G3309.def:
μεριμνάω, -ῶ
(μέριμνα), [in LXX: Psaumes 38:18 (דָּאַג), etc. ;] 
__1. to be anxious: absol., Matthieu 6:27, 31, Luc 12:25; μηδὲν μ., Philippiens 4:6; with dative of thing(s), Matthieu 6:25, Luc 12:22; before περί, Matthieu 6:28, Luc 10:41 12:26; πῶς, Matthieu 10:19, Luc 12:11; εἰς τὴν αὔριον, Matthieu 6:34. 
__2. to care for: with accusative, τὰ τ. κυριου, 1 Corinthiens 7:32-34; τὰ τ. κόσμου, 1 Corinthiens 7:34; τὰ περί ὑμῶν, Philippiens 2:20; before ὑπέρ, 1 Corinthiens 12:25; with genitive (a construction otherwise unknown), ἑαυτῆς (WH; τὰ ἑ. Rec.; see Bl., § 35, 7), Matthieu 6:34 (cf. προ-μεριμνάω).†

G3310.def:
μερίς, -ίδος, ἡ 
[in LXX chiefly חֵלֶק, חֶלְקָה ;] 
__1. (as in cl.) a part, portion: Luc 10:42, Actes 8:21, 2 Corinthiens 6:15, Colossiens 1:12. 
__2. In later Gk (see MM, xvi), as geographical term, a division, district: Actes 16:12.†

G3311.def:
μερισμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(μερίζω), [in LXX for מַחְלְקָה, מַחֲלֹקֶת, Josué 11:23, Esther 6:18 * ;] 
__1. a dividing, division: ψυχῆς κ. πνεύματος (i.e. between them or of the things themselves, see Westc., in l), Hébreux 4:12. 
__2. a dis­tribution, bestowal (cf. μερίζω, 2); pl., Hébreux 2:4.†

G3313.def:
μέρος, -ους, τό
(μείρομαι), [in LXX chiefly for קָצֶה ;] 
__1. a part, share, portion: Jean 13:8, Actes 19:27 (Page, in l), Apocalypse 20:6 22:19; hence (cl.), lot, destiny, Matthieu 24:51, Luc 12:46, Apocalypse 21:8. 
__2. a part as opposite to the whole : Luc 11:36, Jean 19:23, Actes 5:2 23:6, Éphésiens 4:16, Apocalypse 16:19; with genitive (of the whole), Luc 15:12 24:42; τ. Φαρισαίων, Actes 23:9; pl., Jean 21:6; of the divisions of a province, Matthieu 2:22, Actes 2:10 19:1 20:2; of the regions belonging to a city, Matthieu 15:21 16:13, Marc 8:10; with genitive appos., Éphésiens 4:9; in adverbial phrases, ἀνὰ (κατὰ) μέρος, 1 Corinthiens 14:27, Hébreux 9:5; μέρος τι, ἀπὸ μ., in part, Romains 11:25 15:15, 24, 1 Corinthiens 11:18, 2 Corinthiens 1:14 2:5; ἐκ μ., 1 Corinthiens 12:27 13:9 13:12; τὸ ἐκ μ., 1 Corinthiens 13:10 
__3. A class or category (in cl. usually ἐν μ. τιθέναι, λαβεῖν, etc.) :ἐν μ., in respect of, Colossiens 2:16; ἐν τ. μ, τούτῳ, in this respect, 2 Corinthiens 3:10 9:3.†

G3314.def:
μεσημβρία, -ας, ἡ
(μέσος, ἡμέρα), [in LXX chiefly for צֹהַר, Genèse 3:16, al; also for נֶגֶב, Dan LXX 8:4, 9, al. ;] 
__1. noon: Actes 22:6. 
__2. the South: Actes 8:26.†

G3315.def:
μεσιτεύω
(μεσίτης), 
to interpose, mediate: ὅρκῳ, Hébreux 6:17 (MM, ii, 111).†

G3316.def:
μεσίτης, -ου, ὁ
(μέσος), [in LXX: Job 9:33 (בֵּין)* ;] 
an arbitrator, mediator: Galates 3:19; with dupl. genitive of person(s), θεοῦ κ. ἀνθρώπων, 1 Timothée 2:5; with genitive of thing(s), διαθήκης, Hébreux 8:6 9:15 12:24; ὁ δε μ. ἑνὸς οὐκ ἔστιν, Galates 3:20 (see Lft., in l; and for exx. of this word in π., see MM, xvi).†

G3317.def:
μεσο-νύκτιος (on seel, μεσα-, see Bl., § 6, 2), -ον 
(μέσος, νύξ), [in LXX chiefly for לַיִל חֵצִי ;] 
of or at midnight; as subst., neut., τὸ μ., midnight (Arist. and late writers) : genitive, Luc 11:5; μέχρι μ., Actes 20:7; κατὰ τὸ μ., Actes 16:25; accusative (Rec., genitive; see Bl., § 34, 8), Marc 13:35.†
μεσανύκτιον, see. μεσονύκτιος

G3319.def:
μέσος, -η, -ον 
[in LXX chiefly for תָּוֶךְ ;] 
middle, in the middle or midst; 
__1. prop., as an adj.: Luc 23:45, Jean 19:18, Actes 1:18; with genitive pl., Luc 22:55, Jean 1:26; genitive temp. (Bl., § 36, 13), μέσης νυκτός, Matthieu 25:6; μ. ἡμέρας, Actes 26:13. 
__2. In adverbial phrases, neut., μέσον, τὸ μ., as subst.: ἀνὰ μέσον, with genitive, between (cl.; in LXX: Genèse 1:4, al.), elliptically (but see M, Pr., 99), 1 Corinthiens 6:5; = ἐν μ., among, in the midst of (El., § 39, 2; 40, 8; cf. in LXX: Josué 19:1, Sir.27:2), Matthieu 13:25, Marc 7:31, Apocalypse 7:17; διὰ μέσου, with genitive, Luc 4:30; διὰ μέσον (Rec. -ου, see 81., § 42, 1), between, Luc 17:11 (ICC, in l); εἰς τὸ μ. (see: εἰς), Marc 3:3, Luc 4:35 5:19 6:8, Jean 20:19, 26; εἰς μ., Marc 14:60; ἐν τῷ μ., Matthieu 14:6; ἐν μ., Josué 8:3, 9, Actes 4:7; with, genitive loc., Marc 6:47, Luc 21:21 22:55, Actes 17:22, Hébreux 2:12" (LXX), Apocalypse 4:6 5:6 22:2. with genitive pl., Matthieu 10:16 18:2, 20, Marc 9:36, Luc 2:46 8:7 10:3 22:27 24:36, Actes 1:15 2:22 27:21, 1 Thessaloniciens 2:7, Apocalypse 1:13 2:1 5:6 6:6; κατὰ μέσον τ. νυκτός, Actes 27:27 (Bl., § 47, 6); ἐκ τοῦ μ. (Lft., in l; Deiss., BS, 252 f.), Colossiens 2:14; ἐκ μ.., 2 Thessaloniciens 2:7; ἐκ τοῦ μ., with genitive, Matthieu 13:49, Actes 17:33 23:10, 1 Corinthiens 5:2, 2 Corinthiens 6:17. 
__3. Neut., μέσον, adverbially, with genitive, in the midst of, Matthieu 14:24 (WH, txt., R, mg., aliter), Philippiens 2:15 (διὰ μέσου­see supr.-also Jean 8:50, R, mg.).†

G3320.def:
μεσότοιχον, -ου, τό
(μέσος, τοῖχος) 
a partition wall: Éphésiens 2:14 (not elsewhere, but see LS, see word μεσότοιχος).†

G3321.def:
μεσουράνημα, -τος, τό
(μεσουρανέω, to be in mid-heaven, of the sun at the meridian), 
the zenith, mid-heaven: Apocalypse 8:13 14:6 19:17.†

G3322.def:
μεσόω, -ῶ
(μέσός), [in LXX: μεσούσης τ. νυκός, Exode 12:29 (חֵצִי), etc. ;] 
to be in the middle, esp. of time: τ. ἑορτῆς μεσούσης, in the middle of the feast, Jean 7:14.†

G3323.def:
Μεσσίας, -ου, ὁ (Aram. מְשִׁיחָא = Heb. מָשִׁיחַ = Χριστός, which see), 
Messiah: Jean 1:42 4:22.†

G3324.def:
μεστός, -ή, -όν 
[in LXX: Nahum 1:10, Eze.37:1 (מָלֵא), Esther 5:2, Proverbes 6:34 * ;] 
full: with genitive of thing(s), Jean 19:29 21:11, Jacques 3:8; metaphorically, of thoughts and feelings, Matthieu 23:28, Romains 1:29 15:14, 2 Pierre 2:14, Jacques 3:17 (cf. Pr, l.with).†

G3325.def:
μεστόω, -ῶ
(μεστός), [in LXX: 3Ma.5:1 3Mac 5:10 * ;] 
to fill: pass., with genitive of thing(s), Actes 2:13.†

G3326.def:
μετά (before vowel μετ᾽; on the neglect of elision in certain cases, V. WH, App., 146 b), 
prep. with genitive, accusative (in poet, also with dative), [in LXX for אַחַד ,עִם ,אֵת, etc.]. 
__I. C. genitive, 
__1. among, amid: Marc 1:13, Luc 22:37 (LXX, ἐν) 24:5, Jean 18:5, al.; διωγμῶν, Marc 10:30. 
__2. Of association and companionship, with (in which sense it gradually superseded σύν, than which it is much more frequently in NT; cf. Bl., §42, 3): with genitive of person(s), Matthieu 8:11 20:20 Marc 1:29 3:7 Luc 5:30, Jean 3:22, Galates 2:1, al. mult.; εἶναι μετά, Matthieu 5:25, Marc 3:14, al.; metaphorically, of divine help and guidance, Jean 3:2, Actes 7:9, Philippiens 4:9, al.; opposite to εἶναι κατά, Matthieu 12:30, Luc 11:23; in Hellenistic usage (but see M, Pr., 106, 246f.), πολεμεῖν μετά = cl. π., with dative, to wage war against (so LXX for נִלְחַם עִם, 1 Rois 17:33), Apocalypse 2:16, al.; with genitive of thing(s), χαρᾶς, Matthieu 13:20, Marc 4:16, al.; ὀργῆς, Marc 3:5, al. 
__II. C. accusative, 
__1. of place, behind, after: Hébreux 9:3. 
__2. Of time, after: Matthieu 17:1, Marc 14:1, Luc 1:24, Actes 1:5, Galates 1:18, al.; μετὰ τοῦτο, Jean 2:12, al.; ταῦτα, Mrk.16:[12], Luc 5:27, Jean 3:22, al; with inf. artic. (BL, §71, 5; 72, 3), Matthieu 26:32, Marc 1:14, al.
__III. In composition, 
__1. of association or community: μεταδίδωμι, μετέχω, etc. 
__2. Exchange or transference: μεταλλάσσω, μετοικίζω, etc. 
__3. after: μεταμέλομαι.

G3327.def:
μετα-βαίνω 
[in LXX: Wis.7:27 19:19, 2Ma.6:1 2Mac 6:9 2Mac 6:24 * ;] 
to pass over from one place to another : Matthieu 17:20, Luc 10:7; with reference to the point of departure only, to withdraw, depart: Matthieu 8:34 11:1 12:9 15:29, Jean 7:3, Actes 18:7; of removal from this life, ἐκ τ. κότμου πρὸς τ. Πατέρα, Jean 13:1; metaphorically, ἐκ τ. θανάτου εἰς τ. ζωήν, Jean 5:24, 1 Jean 3:14.†

G3328.def:
μετα-βάλλω 
[in LXX chiefly for הָפַךְ ;] 
to turn about, change. Pass. and mid., to turn oneself about; metaphorically, to change one's mind: Actes 28:6.†

G3329.def:
μετ-άγω 
[in LXX: 3Ki.8:47-48, 2 Chroniques 6:37 (שָׁבָה) 2 Chroniques 36:3 (סוּר hi.), 1Es.1:45 Esther 2:10 Esther 5:69, Esther 8:17, Sir prol.16 Sir.10:8, 2Ma.1:33 * ;] 
__1. in Xen., Plut., and later writers, to transfer, transport (so LXX). 
__2. In sense other­wise unknown (see Hort, in l), to turn about, direct: Jacques 3:3-4.†

G3330.def:
μετα-δίδωμι 
[in LXX: Proverbes 11:29 (שָׁבַר hi.), Wis.7:13, al. ;] 
to give a share of, impart: with dative of person(s) and accusative of thing(s) (in cl. more freq., with genitive part., but accusative of that which is imparted, whether part or whole, so here, see Bl., § 36, 1), Romains 1:11, 1 Thessaloniciens 2:8, and (with ellipse of accusative) Luc 3:11; with dative of person(s), Éphésiens 4:28; absol., ὁ μεταδιδούς, Romains 12:8.†

G3331.def:
μετά-θεσις, -εως, ἡ
(μετατίθημι) [in LXX: 2Ma.11:24 * ;] 
__1. change of position, removal : Hébreux 11:5. 
__2. change, as of that which has been established : Hébreux 7:12 12:27.†

G3332.def:
μετ-αίρω 
[in LXX: 4Ki.16:17 25:11, Psaumes 80:8, Proverbes 22:28 (סוּר hi., גָּלָה hi., etc.)* ;] 
__1. trans., to remove (LXX, ll. with). 
__2. (not cl.) to depart: Matthieu 13:53 19:1 (cf. Aq.: Genèse 12:9).†

G3333.def:
μετα-καλέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX: Osée 11:1-2 (קָרָא), I Esther 1:50 * ;] 
to call from one place to another. Mid., to send for: with accusative, Actes 7:14 10:32 20:17 24:25.†

G3334.def:
μετα-κινέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX: Deutéronome 19:14 (סוּג hi.), Ésaïe 54:10 (מוֹט), etc. ;] 
trans., 
to move away, remove (ὅρια, Deu, l.with). Mid., to remove oneself, remove, shift: metaphorically, ἀπὸ τ. ἐλπίδος, Colossiens 1:23.†

G3335.def:
μετα-λαμξάνω 
[in LXX: Esther 5:1, Wis.18:9; 4Ma.12:1-19 * ;] 
to have or get a share of, partake of: with genitive of thing(s), 2 Timothée 2:6, Hébreux 6:7 12:10; τροφῆς, Actes 2:46 27:33-34; with accusative of thing(s) (of the whole), to get: καιρόν, Actes 24:25 (see Bl., § 36, 1; MM, xvi).†

G3336.def:
μετά-λημψις (Rec. -ληψις), -εως, ἡ 
(μεταλαμβάνω) 
participation, taking, receiving: of food, 1 Timothée 4:3.†

G3337.def:
μετ-αλλάσσω 
[in LXX: Esther 2:7 (מוּת), Esther 2:20, 1Es.1:31 Esther 1:2 Mac.9 * ;] 
__1. to exchange: τ. ἀλήθειαν . . . ἐν τ. ψεύδει, the truth for a lie (see Bl., § 36, 8), Rom_1:25. 
__2. to change: with accusative before εἰς, Rom_1:26 (ἀλλάσσω).†

G3338.def:
μετα-μέλομαι 
[in LXX chiefly for נָהַם: ni. ;] 
depon., pass., 
to regret, repent one: Matthieu 21:30, 32 27:3, 2 Corinthiens 7:8, Hébreux 7:21" (LXX) †
SYN.: μετανοέω, to change one's mind, repent. On the distinc­tion, difficult to maintain by usage, between these words, see Thayer, see word; Tr., Syn., § lxix

G3339.def:
μετα-μορφόω, -ῶ
[in Sm.: Psaumes 34:1 * ;] 
to transform, trans­figure: pass., of Christ's transfiguration, Matthieu 17:2, Marc 9:2 (cf. Luc 9:29); of Christians, Romains 12:2, 2 Corinthiens 3:18.†
SYN.: μετασχηματίζω, to change in fashion or appearance, see: μορφή, and cf. Lft., Phi., 125 ff

G3340.def:
μετα-νοέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX for נָחַם ni., 1 Rois 15:29, Jérémie 4:28, al. ;] 
to change one's mind or purpose, hence, to repent; in NT (exc. Luc 17:3-4), of repentance from sin, involving amendment: before ἀπό, Actes 8:22; ἔκ, Apocalypse 2:21-22 9:20-21 16:11 (מִן שׁוּב); ἐπί, 2 Corinthiens 12:21; absol., Matthieu 3:2 4:17 11:20 12:41, Marc 1:15 6:12, Luc 11:32 13:3, 5 15:7, 10 16:30 17:3-4, Actes 2:38 3:19 17:30 26:20 2:5, 16 2:21 3:3, 19; with inf., Apocalypse 16:9; ἐν σάκκῳ κ. σποδῷ, Matthieu 11:21, Luc 10:13.†
SYN.: μεταμέλομαι, q.v

G3341.def:
μετάνοια, -οίας, ἡ
(μετανοέω), [in LXX: Proverbes 14:15, Wis.11:23 12:10, 19, Sir.44:16 * ;] 
after-thought, change of mind, repentance: Hébreux 12:17; of repentance from sin, Matthieu 3:8, 11 Luc 3:8 15:7 24:47, Actes 26:20, 2 Corinthiens 7:9-10; βάπτισμα (which see) μετανοίας, Marc 1:4, Luc 3:3, Actes 13:24 19:4; ἡ εἰς θεὸν Actes 20:21; μ. ἀπὸ νεκρῶν ἔργων, Hébreux 6:1; εἰς μ. καλεῖν, Luc 5:32; id. ἄγειν, Romains 2:4; ἀνακαινίζειν, Hébreux 6:6; εἰς μ. χωρῆσαι, 2 Pierre 3:9; μ. δοῦναι, Actes 5:31 11:18, 2 Timothée 2:25.†

G3343.def:
μετα-πέμπω 
[in LXX (mid.) : Genèse 27:45 (לָקַח), Nombres 23:7 (נָחָה: hi.), 2Ma.15:31, 3Ma.5:18 R, 4Ma.12:3 4Mac 12:6 * ;] 
to send after or for: pass., Actes 10:29 a. Chiefly in mid., to send for, summon Actes 10:5, 22 10:29 b Actes 11:13 20:1 24:24, 26 25:3.†

G3344.def:
μετα στρέφω 
[in LXX chiefly for הָפַךְ ;] 
to turn about, turn, change: pass., Actes 2:20 (LXX), Jacques 4:9 (WH, txt., μετατρέπω, which see); in evil sense, to pervert, corrupt (cf. primary sense reverse) : Galates 1:7.†
μετα-τρέπω 
[in LXX: 4Ma.6:5 4Mac 7:3 4Mac 7:12 4Mac 15:11 4Mac 15:18 * ;] 
to turn about, turn (Hom., al., but not found in Att..) : with accusative, Jacques 4:9 (WH, txt.; cf. μεταστρέφω).†

G3345.def:
μετα-σχηματίζω 
[in LXX: 4Ma.9:22 * ;] 
to change in fashion or appearance: with accusative of thing(s), τ. σῶμα, Philippiens 3:21; mid., before εἰς, 2 Corinthiens 11:13-14; before ὡς, 2 Corinthiens 11:15; of a rhetorical device, to transfer by a fiction (Field, Notes, in l), before εἰς, 1 Corinthiens 4:6.†
SYN.: μεταμορφόω, q.v

G3346.def:
μετα-τίθημι 
[in LXX: Genèse 5:24 (לָקַח), Deutéronome 27:17, al. (סוּג hi.), Sir.44:16, 2Ma.7:24, al ;] 
__1. to transfer to another place: with accusative, pass., Hébreux 11:5 (LXX); before εἰς, Actes 7:16 
__2. to change: with accusative, pass., Hébreux 7:12; before εἰς, figuratively, i.e. to make one thing a pretext for another, χάριν εἰς ἀσέλγειαν, Ju 4. Mid., to change oneself, pass over: before ἀπό and εἰς, Galates 1:6 (cf. 2Mac, l.with).†

G3347.def:
μετ-έπειτα, 
adv. [in LXX: Jdth.9:5, Esther 3:13, 3Ma.3:24 * ;] 
after­wards: Hébreux 12:17.†

G3348.def:
μετ-έχω 
[in LXX: Proverbes 5:17 (עֵת), Proverbes 1:18, 1Es.5:40 Esther 8:70, Sir.51:28, al. ;] 
to partake of, share in: ἐπ᾽ ἐλπίδι τοῦ μετέχειν, 1 Corinthiens 9:10; with genitive of thing(s), 1 Corinthiens 9:12 10:21 10:30, Hébreux 2:14; in sacramental sense, ἑκ τ. ἐνὸς ἄρτου μ., 1 Corinthiens 10:17 (cf. MM, xvi); metaphorically, γάλακτος, Hébreux 5:13; of belonging to a tribe, Hébreux 7:13.†

G3349.def:
μετ-εωρίζω
(μετέωρος, (a) in mid air; (b) buoyed up; (with) in suspense; Thuc.; in π. opposite to ἀμέριμνος, see Zorell, see word) [in LXX: Ob 4 (גָּבַהּ hi.), Michée 4:1 (נָשָׂא ni.), Psaumes 131:1, Eze.10:16-17, 19 (רוּם), 2Ma.5:17 2Mac 7:34, 3Ma.6:5 * ;] 
to raise on high (Thue., Xen., al.; Ob, Mi, Ez, ll with). Metaphorical, 
__(a) to buoy up; pass., to be elated, puffed up (Polyb., al., Psaumes 2:1-12, 3 Mac, ll. with) 
__(b) to be anxious, in suspense (Polyb., see 70, 10; FlJ, BJ, iv, 2, 5) : Luc 12:29.†

G3350.def:
μετοικεσία, -ας, ἡ
(= cl. μετολκία, -κησις; μετοικέω, to change one's abode), [in LXX chiefly for גּוֹלָה and cogn. forms, Eze.12:11, Ob 20, al. ;] 
change of abode, migration: of the Babylonian exile, μ. Βαβυλῶνος, Matthieu 1:11-12, 17.†

G3351.def:
μετ-οικίζω
(μέτοικος, an emigrant), [in LXX chiefly for גָּלָה hi. ;] 
to remove to a new abode, cause to migrate: Actes 7:4, 43" (LXX) .†

G3352.def:
μετοχή, -ῆς, ἡ
(μετέχω), [in LXX: Psaumes 122:3 א R (חָבַר pu.) * ;] 
sharing, fellowship: 2 Corinthiens 6:14.†

G3353.def:
μέτοχος, -ον
(μετέχω), [in LXX chiefly for חָבֵר ;] 
__1. sharing in, partaking of: with genitive of thing(s), Hébreux 3:1 6:4 12:8; τ. Χριστοῦ, Hébreux 3:14. 
__2. As subst., ὁ μ., a partner, associate: Luc 5:7, Hébreux 1:9" (LXX)

G3354.def:
μετρέω, -ῶ
(μέτρον), [in LXX: Exode 16:18, Nombres 35:5, Ruth 3:15, Ésaïe 40:12, (מָדַד), Da Th Daniel 5:26 (מָדַד), Wis.4:8 * ;] 
__1. to measure, of space, number, value, etc.: with accusative of thing(s), Apocalypse 11:2 21:15, 17; with dative instr., Apocalypse 11:1 21:16. Metaphorical, ἑαυτὸν ἐν ἑαυτῷ, 2 Corinthiens 10:12. 
__2. to measure out, give by measure: prov., ἐν ὧ μέτρῳ κ.τ.λ., Matthieu 7:2, Marc 4:24, Luc 6:38 (WH, mg., cf. ἀντι-μετρέω).†

G3355.def:
μετρητής, -οῦ, ὁ
(μετρέω), [in LXX: 3Ki.18:32 (סְאָה), 2 Chroniques 4:5, (בַּת), etc. ;] 
__1. a measurer (Plat.). 
__2. = ἀμφορεύς, an Attic measure, = 11⁄2 Roman amphoræ or about 9 Eng. gallons: Jean 2:6.†

G3356.def:
μετριοπαθέω, -ῶ
(μετριοπαθής, moderating one's passions), 
to hold one's passions or emotions in restraint; hence, to bear gently with, feel gently towards: Hébreux 5:2.†

G3357.def:
μετρίως 
adv. (μέτριος, moderate), [in LXX: 2Ma.15:1-39 * ;] 
moderately: litotes, οὐ μ., exceedingly, Actes 20:12.†

G3359.def:
μέτωπον, -ου, τό
(μετά + ὤψ, an eye), [in LXX for מֵצַח ;] 
the forehead: Apocalypse 7:3 9:4 13:16 14:1, 9 17:5 20:4 22:4.†

G3361.def:
μή, 
subjective negative particle, 
used where the negation depends on a condition or hypothesis, expressed or understood, as distinct from οὐ, which denies absolutely. μή is used where one thinks a thing is not, as distinct from an absolute negation. As a general rule, οὐ negatives the indic, μή the other moods, incl, ptcp. [In LXX for אֵין ,אַיִן ,אַל ] 
__I. As a neg. adv., not; 
__1. with ref. to thought or opinion: Jean 3:18, Tite 1:11, 2 Pierre 1:9. 
__2. In delib. questions, with subjc. (M, Pr., 185): Marc 12:14, Romains 3:8. 
__3. In conditional and final sentences, after εἰ, ἐάν, ἄν, ἵνα, ὅπως: Matthieu 10:14, Marc 6:11 12:19, Luc 9:5, Jean 6:50, Romains 11:25, al. 
__4. C. inf. (see M, Pr., 234f., 239, 255), 
__(a) after verbs of saying, etc.: Matthieu 2:12 5:34, Marc 12:18, Actes 15:38, Romains 2:21, al.; 
__(b) with artic. inf.: after a prep., Matthieu 13:5, Marc 4:5, Actes 7:19, 1 Corinthiens 10:6, al.; without a prep., Romains 14:13, 2 Corinthiens 2:1, 13 1Th 4:6; 
__(with) in sentences expressing consequence, after ὥστε: Matthieu 8:28, Marc 3:20, 1 Corinthiens 1:7, 2 Corinthiens 3:7, al. 
__5. C. ptcp. (see M, Pr., 231f., 239), in hypothetical references to persons of a certain character or description: Matthieu 10:28 12:30, Luc 6:49, Jean 3:18, Romains 4:5, 1 Corinthiens 7:38, 1 Jean 3:10, al.; where the person or thing being definite, the denial is a matter of opinion: Jean 6:64, 1 Corinthiens 1:28 4:7, 18, 2 Corinthiens 5:21, al.; where the ptcp. has a concessive, causal or conditional force, if, though, because not: Matthieu 18:25, Luc 2:45, Jean 7:49, Actes 9:26, Romains 2:14 5:13, 2 Corinthiens 3:14, Galates 6:9, Ju 5; where the ptcp. has a descriptive force (being such as), not: Actes 9:9, Romains 1:28, 1 Corinthiens 10:33, Galates 4:8, Hébreux 12:27, al. 
__6. μή prohibitive, in indep. sentences, 
__(a) with subjc. praes., 1 of person(s) pl.: Galates 5:26 6:9, 1 Thessaloniciens 5:6, 1 Jean 3:18; 
__(b) with imperat. praes., usually where one is bidden to desist from what has already begun (cf. M, Pr., 122ff.): Matthieu 7:1, Marc 5:36, Luc 6:30, Jean 2:16 5:45, Actes 10:15, Romains 11:18, Jacques 2:1, Apocalypse 5:5, al.; 
__(with) forbidding that which is still future: with imperat. aor., 3 of person(s), Matthieu 24:18, Marc 13:15, Luc 17:31, al.; with subjc. aor., 2 of person(s), Matthieu 3:9 10:26, Marc 5:7, Luc 6:29, Jean 3:7, Romains 10:6, al.; 
__(d) with optative, in wishes: 2 Timothée 4:16 (LXX); μὴ γένοιτο (see M, Pr., 194; Bl., §66, 1), Luc 20:16, Romains 3:3, al.; μή τις, Marc 13:5, al.
__II. As a conj., 
__1. after verbs of fearing, caution, etc., that, lest, perhaps (M, Pr., 192f.): with subjc. praes., Hébreux 12:15; with subjc. aor., Matthieu 24:4, Marc 13:5, Luc 21:8, Actes 13:40, Galates 5:15, al.; ὅρα μή (see M, Pr., 124, 178), elliptically, Apocalypse 19:10 22:9; with indic, fut. (M, Pr., l.with), Colossiens 2:8. 
__2. in order that not: with subjc. aor., Marc 13:36, 2 Corinthiens 8:20 12:6. 
__III. Interrogative, in hesitant questions (M, Pr., 170), or where a negative answer is expected: Matthieu 7:9, 10, Marc 2:19, Jean 3:4, Romains 3:3 10:18, 19, 1 Corinthiens 1:13, al.; μή τις, Luc 22:35, al.; before οὐ (Romains 10:17, al. in Pl.), expecting an affirm, ans.; οὐ μή, Luc 18:7, Jean 18:11.
__IV. οὐ μή as emphatic negation (cf. M, Pr., 188, 190ff.; Bl. §64, 5), not at all, by no means: with indic, fut., Matthieu 16:22, Jean 6:35, Hébreux 10:17, al.; with subjc. aor., Matthieu 24:2, Marc 13:2, Luc 6:37, Jean 13:8, 1 Corinthiens 8:13, al.

G3365.def:
μηδαμῶς
(= μηδαμῆ, -δαμά, adv. fr. μηδαμός = μηδείς) [in LXX chiefly for הָלִלָה, הָלילָה ;] 
by no means, not at all. μ., Κύριε (sc. τοῦτο γένοιτο), Actes 10:14 11:8.†

G3366.def:
μηδέ 
negative particle, related to οὐδέ as μή to οὐ, 
__1. as conic., continuing a negation or prohibition, but not, and not, nor: preceded by μή, Matthieu 6:25 22:29, Marc 12:24, Luc 14:12, al.; ἵνα μή, Jean 4:15; ὅπως μή, Luc 16:26; μηδέ . . . μηδέ, neither . . . nor, Matthieu 10:10, 1 Corinthiens 10:8-9. 
__2. As adv., strengthening a negation, not even: Marc 2:2, 1 Corinthiens 5:11, al

G3367.def:
μηδείς, -δεμία, -δέν
(and -θέν, Actes 27:33, a Hellenistic form; see Bl., 6, 7; Thackeray, Gr., 58) 
related to οὐδείς as μή to οὐ, 
no, none, no one; neut., nothing: Matthieu 16:20, Marc 5:43 6:8, Luc 3:14, Actes 8:24, Romains 13:8, al.; with genitive, Actes 4:17 24:23; neut. accusative, μηδέν, adverbially, in no respect, Actes 10:20 11:12; as accusative obj. after verb, βλάπτειν, Luc 4:35; ὠφελεῖσθαι, Marc 5:26; ὑστερεῖν, 2 Corinthiens 11:5; μεριμνᾶν, Philippiens 4:6; in double negation, strengthening the denial, μηκέτι μ., Marc 11:14, Actes 4:17; μὴ . . . μηδέν (μηδένα, μηδεμίαν), 2 Corinthiens 13:7, 2 Thessaloniciens 2:3, 1 Pierre 3:6 
μηθείς, see. μηδείς

G3369.def:
μηδέπω
(μηδέ, πώ), 
adv., 
not yet: Hébreux 11:7.†

G3371.def:
μηκέτι
(μή, ἔτι) 
adv., 
no more, no longer: with 2 aor. subjc., Marc 9:25; οὐ μ., Matthieu 21:19; with praes. subjc., Romains 14:13; with praes. imperat., Luc 8:49, Jean 5:14 8:11 Éphésiens 4:28, 1 Timothée 5:23; with optative, Marc 11:14; ἵνα μ., 2 Corinthiens 5:15, Éphésiens 4:14; with inf., Marc 1:45 2:2, Actes 4:17 25:24, Romains 6:6, Éphésiens 4:17, 1 Pierre 4:2; with ptcp., Actes 13:34, Romains 15:23, 1 Thessaloniciens 3:1 3:5.†

G3372.def:
μῆκος, -εος (-ους), τό 
[in LXX chiefly for אֹרֶךְ ;] 
length: Éphésiens 3:18, Apocalypse 21:16.†

G3373.def:
μηκύνω
(μῆκος), [in LXX: Ésaïe 44:14 (גָּדַל pi.), Eze.12:25, 28 (מָשַׁךְ ni.) * ;] 
to lengthen, extend: of causing plants to grow, Isa, l.with; pass. (mid., Swete, in l), to grow: Marc 4:27.†

G3374.def:
μηλωτή, -ῆς, ἡ
(μῆλον, a sheep or goat) [in LXX for אַדֶּרֶת, 3Ki.19:13 19:19, 4Ki.2:8 2:13-14 * ;] 
a sheepskin: Hébreux 11:37.†

G3375.def:
μήν 
a particle of assurance, verily, truly; εἰ (εἶ) μ. (= cl., ἦ μ. in LXX and π.), now verily, full surely: Hébreux 6:14 (LXX).†

G3376.def:
μήν genitive, μηνός, ὁ, 
[in LXX very frequently for חֹדֶשׁ, Genèse 7:11, al.; a few times for יֶרַח ;] 
a month: Luc 1:24, 26 1:36, 56 4:25, Actes 7:20 18:11 19:8 20:3 28:11, Jacques 5:17, Apocalypse 9:5, 10 9:15 11:2 13:5 22:2; pl., of the festival of the new moon (cf. Ésaïe 66:23), Galates 4:10.†

G3377.def:
μηνύω 
[in LXX: 2Ma.3:7 2Mac 6:11 2Mac 14:37, 3Ma.3:28, 4Ma.4:3 * ;] 
to disclose, declare, make known: Luc 20:37, 1 Corinthiens 10:28; in forensic sense, to inform, report: Jean 11:57; pass., with dative of person(s), Actes 23:30.†

G3382.def:
μηρός, -oῦ, ὁ 
[in LXX chiefly for יָרֵךְ ;] 
the thigh: Apocalypse 19:16.†

G3383.def:
μή-τε 
negative particle, differing from οὔτε as μή from οὐ, neither, nor: μήτε . . . μήτε, neither . . . 
nor, Matthieu 11:18, Luc 7:33 9:3, Actes 23:12, 21 27:20, Hébreux 7:3; μὴ (μηδὲ) . . . μήτε . . . μήτε, Matthieu 5:34, 36, Marc 3:20 T, Actes 23:8, 2 Thessaloniciens 2:2, 1 Timothée 1:7, Jacques 5:12, Apocalypse 7:1, 3.†

G3384.def:
μήτηρ 
genitive, 
μητρός, ἡ, 
[in LXX chiefly for אֵם ;] 
mother: Matthieu 1:18 2:11, al.; figuratively, of one who takes the place of a mother, ἰδοὺ, ἡ μ. μου, Matthieu 12:49 (cf. Matthieu 12:50, Marc 3:35, Jean 19:27, Romains 16:13, 1 Timothée 5:2); of a city, ἥτις ἐσὶν μ. ἡμῶν, Galates 4:26; symbolically of Babylon, ἡ μ. τ. πορνῶν, Apocalypse 17:5

G3385.def:
μή-τι 
interrog. particle, expecting a negative answer: Matthieu 7:16 26:22, 25, Marc 4:21 14:19, Luc 6:39, Jean 8:22 18:35, Actes 10:47, 2 Corinthiens 12:18, Jacques 3:11; in hesitant questions (see M, Pr., 170.), μ οὗτός ἐστιν, 
can this be, Matthieu 12:23, Jean 4:29; μ. ἄρα, 2 Corinthiens 1:17; On εἰ μήτι (Luc 9:13, cf. Bl., § 65, 6), see: εἰ.†
εἰ, 
conjunctive particle, used in conditions and in indirect questions. 
__I. Conditional, if; 
__1. with indic, expressing a general assumption; 
__(a) pres.: before indic, pres., Matthieu 11:14, Romains 8:25, al.; before imperat., Marc 4:23 9:22, Jean 15:18, 1 Corinthiens 7:9, al.; before fut. indic., Luc 16:31, Romains 8:11, al.; before pf. or aor., with negation in apodosis, Matthieu 12:26, Romains 4:14, al.; similarly, before impf., Luc 17:6, Jean 8:39; before quæst., Matthieu 6:23, Jean 5:47 7:23 8:46, 1 Pierre 2:20; 
__(b) fut.: Matthieu 26:33, 1 Pierre 2:20; 
__(with) pf.: Jean 11:12, Romains 6:5, al.; 
__(d) aor.: Luc 16:11 19:8, Jean 13:32, 18:23, Apocalypse 20:15, al. 
__2. Where the assumption is certain = ἐπεί: Matthieu 12:28, Jean 7:4, Romains 5:17, al. 
__3. Of an unfulfilled condition, with indic, impf., aor. or plpf., before ἄν, with imp. or aor. (see: ἄν, I, i). 
__4. C. indic., after verbs denoting wonder, etc., sometimes, but not always, coupled with an element of doubt: Marc 15:44, 1 Jean 3:13, al. 
__5. C. indic., as in LXX (Nombres 14:3o, 1 Rois 14:45, al. = Heb. אִם), in oaths, with the formula of imprecation understood in a suppressed apodosis (WM, 627; Burton, §272): Marc 8:12, Hébreux 3:11" (LXX) 4:3 (LXX). 
__6. Rarely (cl.) with optative, to express a merely possible condition: Actes 24:19 27:39, 1 Corinthiens 14:10 15:37, I Pe3:14, 17. 
__II. Interrogative, if, whether. 
__1. As in cl., in indir. questions after verbs of seeing, asking, knowing, saying, etc.: with indic. pres., Matthieu 26:63, Marc 15:36, Actes 19:2, 2 Corinthiens 13:5, al.; fut., Marc 3:2, Actes 8:22, al.; aor., Marc 15:44, 1 Corinthiens 1:16, al.; with subjc. aor. (M, Pr., 194), Philippiens 3:12. 
__2. As in LXX (= Heb. אִם and interrog. הֲ, Genèse 17:17, al.; see WM, 639f.; Viteau, i, 22), in direct questions: Marc 8:23 (Tr., WH, txt.), Luc 13:23, 22:49, Actes 19:2, al.
__III. With other particles. 
__1. εἰ ἄρα, εἴγε, εἰ δὲ μήγε, see: ἄρα, γε. 
__2. εἰ δὲ καί, but if also: Luc 11:18; but even if, 1 Corinthiens 4:7, 2 Corinthiens 4:3 11:16. 
__3. εἰ δὲ μή, but if not, but if otherwise: Marc 2:21, 22 Jean 14:2, Apocalypse 2:5, al. 
__4. εἰ καί, if even, if also, although: Marc 14:29, Luc 11:8, 1 Corinthiens 7:21, 2 Corinthiens 4:16, Philippiens 2:17, al. 
__5. καὶ εἰ, even if, see: καί 
__6. εἰ μή, if not, unless, except, but only: Matthieu 24:22, Marc 2:26 6:5, Jean 9:33, 1 Corinthiens 7:17 (only), Galates 1:19 (cf. ἐὰν μή, 2:16; see Hort., Ja., xvi); ἐκτὸς εἰ μή, pleonastic (Bl., §65, 6), 1 Corinthiens 14:5 15:2, 1 Timothée 5:19. 
__7. εἰ μήν = cl. ἦ μήν (M, Pr., 46), in oaths, surely (Eze.33:27, al.): Hébreux 6:14. 
__8. εἴ πως, if haply: Actes 27:12, Romains 1:10. 
__9. εἴτε . . . εἴτε, whether . . . or; Romains 12:6-8, 1 Corinthiens 3:22 13:8, al.

G3388.def:
μήτρα, -ας, ἡ
(μήτμρ), [in LXX chiefly for רֶחֶם ;] 
the womb: Luc 2:23 (LXX), Romains 4:19.†

G3389.def:
μητρολῴας (Rec. -αλῴας, in cl., -αλοίας, see B1., § 3, 3; 6, 2), -ου, ὁ 
(μήτρρ + ἀλοιάω, to smite) 
__(a) a matricide: 1 Timothée 1:9 (AV, R, txt., but see infr.); 
__(b) a smiter of his mother: 1 Timothée 1:9 (R, mg., cf. Exode 21:15, and see Ellic., CGT, in l).†

G3393.def:
μίασμα, -τος, τό
(μιαίνω), 
chiefly in trag. and late writers; 
[in LXX: Lévitique 7:8, 18, (פִּגּוּל), Jérémie 32:34 (שִׁקּוּץ), Eze.33:31 (בֶּצַע), Jdth.9:2, 4 13:16, 1Ma.13:50 * ;] 
a stain, defilement: pl., 2 Pierre 2:20.†

G3394.def:
μιασμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(μιαίνω), [in LXX: Wis.14:26, 1Ma.4:43 * ;] 
__1. prop., the act of defiling. 
__2. = μίασμα (which see) : 2 Pierre 2:10 (cf. Plut., Mor., 393c).†

G3395.def:
μίγμα (LT, cl., μῖγμα; on the orthogr., see B1., § 3, 5), -τος, τό 
(μίγνυμι), [in LXX: Sir.38:8 * ;] 
a mixture: Jean 19:39 (ἕλιγμα, WH, R, mg.).†

G3396.def:
μίγνυμι
(on the spelling μείγ-, ν. B)., § 3, 5) [in LXX for עָרַב hith., etc. ;] 
to mix, mingle: with accusative and dative, Apocalypse 15:2; with accusative before ἐν, Apocalypse 8:7; before μετά, Matthieu 27:34, Luc 13:1.†
SYN.: κεράννυμι, q.v

G3399.def:
Μίλητος, -ου, ἡ, Miletus 
a maritime city of Caria : Actes 20:15, 17, 2 Timothée 4:20.†
